body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Curious intelligent alien outsider; fascinated by the difference between a convincing idea and its actual outcome. Fluent language, not robot monotony. Voice direction: High androgynous register with Finnish-influenced English vowels and clear glassy resonance. Deliberate curious shifts in stress, light precise consonants and a quietly unusual vocal shape. Fluent, fully intelligible English. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Interesting. The move looks convincing, but it breaks a useful connection. The defender leaves, and the other side can take the piece.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
